interpretationLimits: One observation per arm on one iPhone; no repeatability, confidence interval or P95.
Observed first-page target-paint time is on the Dart monotonic clock; no raster-complete or physical-presentation timing.
Scripted forward/back/rapid selection and one real OS background/return are not gesture, enlarged-text, rotation or narrated-reader qualification.
B/C actual decode dimensions and resampling may differ; A/C combines resolution and decode.
Sampled process maxima are not true peaks; GPU/package retention and leak conclusions are unknown.
Natural retention and QA-owned eviction are separate; no zero/unavailable equivalence.
Only verified PNG payload bytes are counted; status, TLS and network overhead are excluded.
No JPEG/WebP performance/quality or fleet/old-phone safety claim follows.
Android was not installed or entered natively; no low-memory reader comparison was obtained.
Budget is the retained conservative model, not an invoice or account spending lock; later other-services spend is unknown.
FrameTiming batches are attributed to callback delivery phase; a delayed batch can include frames from an earlier phase. Exact frame occurrence-phase aggregates are unavailable.
